ⓘ What happens next?

What happens next?

① Request submitted → Pending review

② Admin approves → Awaiting physical item

③ Item received → Inspection

④ Admin checks condition → Ready for listing

⑤ Final approval → Live marketplace

⑥ Sale → Payment and fulfilment

⑦ Seller payout → Commission deducted

Seller-controlled pricing

The seller sets the asking price. Admin approval does not authorise changing it. Negotiated offers require seller acceptance.

30-day review

Unsold items are flagged for review 30 days after publication. No automatic discount or return is applied.

Seller chooses the asking price. Submission does not publish a listing. En_Collectible must approve the request, physically receive and inspect the item, then approve the listing for publication.

Enter an asking price to preview commission.

A live version will require actual photo uploads, seller verification and a signed consignment agreement.

Commission applies to the full final sale price. Below S$500: 10%; S$500–999.99: 9%; S$1,000–1,499.99: 8%; S$1,500–1,999.99: 7%; S$2,000–2,499.99: 6%; S$2,500 and above: 5%. No minimum fee has been applied. Payment, shipping, tax and refund costs are excluded.
